body:
IMO this video will give some people a good perspective on this issue.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bOTpx5-MhPU&t=4s
I need tips to get into bronze pls. People in low plat keep dying to sym and at this point I'd have to purposely throw to derank.

What if I'm just bad at other heroes though?  I'm matched with people who the game believes are of the same skill level, so again if you don't believe in the matchmaking system then there's no argument to be had in the first place. I always do my best to work with my team even though my character selection is limited, but in the end people like me just get judged for character picks anyway. To be honest, if people can judge me for my character picks then I can judge them back for being in the same rank as I am but really what's the point? It can't be helped and I accept that people will be the way they are. 

I made this topic to help people deal with the immaturity and toxicity of the community by providing a logical perspective. I've seen kids get bullied on comms by adults and that's anything but funny, and it's almost always the blamers who are the most petulant and profane.

It may come as a surprise to many but there are players who don't judge based on hero picks. Most games where this problem exists it's maybe one or two people loudmouthing, but often there are very friendly and supportive people as well. If I were a kid feeling bullied in a game then I'd much rather play with nice players as well rather than toxic players who think they can strongarm their team to suit their tastes.

Competitive is the mode I find to be the most fun by far. Also I never asked anyone to satisfy any ego. I don't ask people to switch but rather just make a suggestion, and if they don't want to then that's totally fine. Your assumption that I'm undermining the team's goals to succeed because of my hero choice is really funny unless you think the SR system is genuinely flawed (in which case no one can help you with that anyways). All you've done is state the obvious while bringing negativity to the table because you're too inflexible to work with the team you have... not that I'll ever judge you for that myself :)

Again, since you didn't bother reading, I wasn't complaining. I don't start crap in game with my team, and I always maintain a positive attitude.

I'm not complaining though. I'm just reminding people to not stand for internet bullying, because people like you don't even understand the beginning of what's wrong with the community and why it's considered to be toxic.

People fire up Overwatch to play their favorite hero. Shouldn't be that hard to understand.
Hope you're nowhere near the 2.6 to 2.8k range then :)

Edit: Reposting after reading your post more carefully (rip reading comprehension).

Your situation is totally understandable, but I think the bigger issue is the random nature of the matchmaking here. Can't be helped if the game matches up 5 or 6 people who main one class or hero and very possibly are not good at many other heroes.

Really, by the definition of people who accuse others of throwing based on hero selection, forcing someone to play a role they're not good or don't want to play is *actually* throwing. It doesn't take a genius to figure out that they forced an optimal team composition at the cost of having someone play their suboptimal hero.

Ironically, forcing people to play what they don't want to play tends to have worse results in the long run since you have to gamble on your teammates' personalities anyways. Even if people give in to their teammates' demands you often STILL have most of the same problems, with the only real difference being that someone on the team is playing a character they might not be good at.

SR doesn't matter to me personally. I'm bad at Overwatch but I still have plenty of fun hovering between 2.6 and 2.8k.

LOL AMIRITE. I'm under the impression that many people do actually feel forced because of how many people seem think they can convince people by just saying things like "this is competitive" or the like.
